name: Industrial Applied Electric
old_description: At IAE, we provide top-tier service, reliable stock, and fast delivery to keep Central Oregon’s industries running. Count on us for the essential parts you need—on time, every time.
about:
Industrial Applied Electric (IAE) was founded in 1976 in Bend, Oregon. The company operates a local warehouse in the Tri‑County area of Central Oregon, serving as a supplier of industrial and fleet maintenance products.

IAE distributes a broad range of maintenance, repair, and operations supplies. Its catalog includes starters, alternators, Deka batteries, impact sockets, rubber tracks for excavators and skid steers, Texas Refinery lubricants, Zep industrial cleaners, Milwaukee tool bundles, Hella lighting, and various heavy‑machinery electrical components. The company emphasizes a fully stocked warehouse that enables same‑day pickup and scheduled delivery throughout the region.

Customers include fleet operators, heavy‑equipment contractors, and industrial maintenance shops across Central Oregon. The company references clients such as M & S Equipment Services and Matrix Integrated, the latter noting that IAE responded after hours to restore production machinery. Mechanics and shop managers also rely on IAE for hard‑to‑find parts, hand tools, and shop consumables.

IAE highlights its 50‑plus years of experience, a fully stocked local warehouse, and knowledgeable staff as key differentiators. The company states that its focus on fast, reliable procurement helps customers minimize downtime and keep projects on schedule.
